description: Record a DRAFT A/B experiment comparing an agent's current model (control) with a candidate (treatment) model. Creating it does NOT start routing traffic: the experiment is stored with status 'draft'. If control_model is omitted, the API uses the model the agent ran most often in the last 90 days (and refuses if it cannot determine one, or if it equals the treatment). Needs an API key with the 'admin' scope (an org owner or admin mints one in Settings → Security → API Keys). Do NOT use to read results — use get_experiment_results. Requires an API key with the 'admin' scope.

control_model.description: Baseline model. Omit to use the agent's most-used model of the last 90 days.

traffic_pct.description: Planned percentage of traffic for the treatment model, 1-50 (default: 10)

name: metrx_create_model_experiment
title: Create Model Experiment
